note: Prefer scenarios/history_hooks.json — broader US-audience History Hooks pack. This file kept for backward compatibility; generate_script loads history_hooks.json first.

scenarios.name: Failed Before Fame
scenarios.angle: Someone dismissed as a failure later becomes essential to American history.
scenarios.hook_style: Open with their lowest point before revealing what they became.

scenarios.name: Traitor Twist
scenarios.angle: A celebrated hero turns and becomes synonymous with betrayal.
scenarios.hook_style: Start as if praising a hero, then flip the knife.

scenarios.name: Refused Power
scenarios.angle: Someone could have taken a crown or lifelong rule — and walked away.
scenarios.hook_style: Contrast conquerors who seize thrones with the one who said no.

scenarios.name: Overlooked Hero
scenarios.angle: A critical figure history textbooks skim past — until you hear what they did.
scenarios.hook_style: You know the famous name. You don't know the person who made it possible.

scenarios.name: Ironic Ending
scenarios.angle: A plan, prophecy, or ambition ends in the opposite of what anyone expected.
scenarios.hook_style: State the intended outcome, then land the historical punchline.

scenarios.name: One Decision
scenarios.angle: A single choice in a room, battlefield, or court rewrites the country's path.
scenarios.hook_style: Zoom into one moment — one vote, one order, one signature.

scenarios.name: Underdog Victory
scenarios.angle: Outgunned, outnumbered, or written off — then they win anyway.
scenarios.hook_style: Stack the odds against them in the first two sentences.
